# Oct 5 Schematic

It took forever to make the schematic because I had to find the right program. I tried KiCad, but it wouldn't work, so I switched to LibrePCB. Then I had to learn how to do it, which took forever, and then I had to find a compatible esp32 and design a schematic around that.
